# The agent-run back office

[Overview](#overview) · [Process sequence](#process-sequence)

## Overview

The monthly money loop with the highest agent ceiling of any recurring playbook here: payroll run, vendors paid, invoices out, books closed, runway read, board updated — roughly nine steps in ten agent-routed, most reachable today over judged MCP servers and CLIs.

Run the linked processes in the recorded chain order. Each process defines its own internal dependencies.
